description: This source file defines the PlotArea class, which represents the drawable area of a chart within the PDFsharp Charting library. It includes methods for cloning and deep copying the object, as well as properties for configuring line and fill formats, and paddings.

classes.name: PlotArea
classes.description: Represents the area where the actual chart is drawn, including properties for formatting and padding, and functionality for cloning.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of this PlotArea object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Implements the deep copy logic for PlotArea and its format properties.
